thread:
li: Heads-up — noticed a weird p95 jump for /v1/generate around 09:12 UTC. Dashboard shows a sharp line but sample count didn't change much. Screenshot: https://img.redwood.internal/abc123 :thinking_face:

miguel: hmm, did anything change in routing or fallback weights?

ops-bot: routing-policy-service deployed routing-change v2 -> v3 at 2024-10-04T09:10:45Z by @deploy-bot :rocket:

li: oh nice catch, ops-bot. The rollback weight to fallback-model went from 0% -> 25% at that time.

sara: is the dashboard attributing samples to the fallback route correctly? we've seen percentile inversion when small-volume but higher-latency routes get blended.

hana: quick thought — are retries included in the percentile calc? retries can inflate p95 if they get tagged to fallback path.

li: query I ran against metrics API:```GET /api/v1/metrics?endpoint=/v1/generate&agg=percentiles&window=5m&include_retries=true```returns p50 120ms, p95 420ms, p99 980ms. If I set include_retries=false p95 drops to 150ms.

miguel: that suggests retries are in the default. Our console UX doesn't surface "sample-source" (primary vs fallback vs retry) by default — we only show route tag in raw logs.

james: long-term fix: surface a tiny badge on percentile lines: [primary] / [fallback] / [retries] or allow stacked breakdown. Short-term: add a warning when route weight shift > 10% during window used for percentiles.

sara: +1 for warning. Also propose an "exclude_retries" toggle in the percentile panel. Low-friction & easy to implement in the frontend query builder.

hana: implementation note — backend percentiles are compiled from tdigest rollups. We need to ensure rollups keep route tag dimensions, otherwise the frontend can't split. Today we merge route dims during ingestion for storage compaction.

miguel: do we have space for a compact route-dim (like single byte) in rollups? could store route bucket id instead of full string to avoid explosion.

li: alternative quick fix: annotate the time series with an event when fallback weight changes and render a vertical line + tooltip explaining the change. That avoids recalculating percentiles but gives context to the spike.

james: both are useful. Event-annotation first, then route-dim rollups. I can sketch the UI: event line + sample-count stacked mini-bars for routes on hover.

sara: i'll take the frontend PR for the toggle + annotation. Will need a small backend flag to paste into the events stream (routing weight changes).

miguel: i'll prototype compact route-dim in the rollup proto and run a storage impact calc. If it looks good we can make the percentile split accurate.

li: for immediate triage, can someone confirm whether retries come from gateway or model runtime? my hunch is gateway triggers retry on 5xx and tags as "retry:path=fallback".

hana: confirmed: gateway issues RETRY with header X-Retry-Reason=upstream_timeout, and we tag metric with retry=true and route=fallback when it goes there.

li: ok thanks. Sara — i'll open a small runbook blurb to check when p95 spikes: 1) check routing events; 2) toggle exclude_retries; 3) inspect per-route sample counts.

sara: sweet. I'll drop a PR link when ready and add a console smoke test.

james: quick UX note: label the toggle as "Exclude retries (recommended for SLO-aligned percentiles)" so customers know why.

li: sounds good. Follow-ups: miguel please paste the storage calc here; sara open PR; james your mock would help. I'll leave this thread open and tag folks for review. :thumbsup:
